title: Dense-gas tracers and carbon isotopes in five 2.5 < z < 4 lensed dusty star-forming galaxies from the SPT SMG sample
question: How much dense, actively star-forming gas (HCN, HCO+, HNC 5-4) and which 13CO/12CO isotopic ratios do lensed SPT dusty star-forming galaxies at 2.5<z<4 show, and how do they compare with local galaxies?

data.sensitivity: designed for 5 sigma (10 sigma for SPT0125-47) HCN detection using Zhang2014 L'HCN-LIR

what.value: Lens magnifications (SPT0551-50 uses the sample median 6.3)

evidence.quote: Data from z-search programs (cite: Weiss2013), fluxes from (cite: Bothwell2016)

what.value: Local LIR-L'HCN(4-3) relation and HCN(4-3) fluxes

evidence.quote: To test if our galaxies follow the relation of (cite: Zhang2014), we converted the L’$_{\rm HCN(5-4)}$ of our objects into L’$_{\rm HCN(4-3)}$
assuming the line ratio measured in the local Universe by (cite: Mills2013)
We adopted the aperture-corrected integrated \[CI\] fluxes published by (cite: Rosenberg2015)

what.value: Stacked SPT line ratios incl. CO(4-3)/CO(3-2)

evidence.loc: 2.7 CO and [CI] lines extracted from ancillary data
evidence.quote: We derived the expected CO(4-3) flux using the line ratio measured in the stacked spectrum of the SPT SMG sources derived by (cite: Spilker2014).

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, manual flagging, CLEAN with natural weighting, channel rebinning
Fit 2D Gaussian to MFS image of all channels, extract spectrum at centroid
assumptions: Dense-gas emission not much more extended than continuum

recipe.method: Gaussian lines plus first-order baseline fitted simultaneously; bootstrap of reshuffled residuals for uncertainties; 3-sigma upper limits = best-fit flux + 3 std
key_parameters: FWHM 200-1000 km/s; velocity offset up to 200 km/s; positivity prior on fluxes; 10 000 bootstraps
assumptions: Same FWHM and velocity offset for all lines in low-S/N sources

recipe.goal: Derive unbiased sample means and line ratios
recipe.method: Combine bootstrap PDFs by random draws (10 000) to get mean luminosity; ratios of mean fluxes weighted by luminosity distance squared; 16th/84th percentiles
Joint fit with common width and velocity offset and positivity prior on both, then mean ratio

recipe.goal: Compare with local LIR-L'HCN relation and line ratios
recipe.method: Convert 5-4 to 4-3 with Mills2013 ratios, correct for magnification, compare with Zhang2014 relation, HCO+/HCN, HNC/HCN, HCN/[CI], HCN/CO, 12CO/13CO
assumptions: Local 5-4/4-3 ratio applies; differential lensing negligible; Planck2015 cosmology, Chabrier IMF

answer_key.value: factor 1.6 (0.20 dex); 2.0 (0.30 dex) after LIR homogenization

evidence.quote: This corresponds to a deficit by a factor of 1.6 (0.20 dex) corresponding to a 2.5 $\sigma$ difference.
found a ratio compatible with unity (1.03$_{-0.39}^{+0.59}$)
We found a mean HNC(5-4)/CN(4-3) ratio of 1.60$_{-0.82}^{+1.74}$.
We found a mean ratio of 26.1$_{-3.5}^{+4.5}$
The line is detected with an S/N of 36.
